title: I'm making a game where you build a tank army, fight alongside it, and turn a tiny factory into absolute battlefield chaos!
author: StrayDogHunt
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋

I'm making **Tank Factory**, a fast-paced action roguelite where you build your own tank army, fight alongside it, and try to survive increasingly ridiculous battles.

You start with a handful of tanks and a commander who can barely keep things under control.

Then the factories start producing. Your army grows. You unlock new weapons, upgrade your tanks, find equipment, and develop your commander into a proper war machine.

One moment you're carefully deciding what to produce. A few minutes later, artillery is raining down, tanks are exploding everywhere, your commander is throwing abilities around, and a massive boss shows up to ruin your carefully constructed plans.

The fun part is that **you're not just watching your army fight**. You're right there in the middle of it, shooting, using skills, and trying to keep your entire operation alive.

I'm a solo developer, and I've been working on connecting the factory production, commander progression, upgrades, and combat into one satisfying gameplay loop.

The game is still in development, but there's already a playable build on itch.io.

[https://lazyassdev.itch.io/tank-factory](https://lazyassdev.itch.io/tank-factory)

I'd really love to hear what you think, especially whether the combat looks fun and the progression makes sense.
